title: Responsive card grid
summary: Three columns on a laptop, one on a phone.
brief: At 800px wide the six cards form three equal columns. At 375px they stack in a single column.
Cards are 12px apart in both directions.
hints: Test both sizes with the 375 and Fit presets above the preview.
A media query works. So does repeat(auto-fill, minmax(…, 1fr)), with no media query at all.
grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)) fits three 220px+ columns at 800px and one at 375px.
solutionNotes: auto-fill makes as many columns as fit at their minimum (220px) and then stretches them equally with 1fr. At 800px three fit; at 375px only one does.
